description: Sensor: Waste Deposit Parking Sensor, Walton Street Picton is a dataset listed in wollondilly-shire-council open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Wollondilly Shire Council. Track the number of vehicles parked at the Waste Deposit grounds. Coverage: Wollondilly, New South Wales. The portal files it under Roads, Parking and Transport. Its keywords are Parking, rv. The portal shows 2020-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-wollondilly-nsw-gov-au-portal.
